bundle.shortDescription: Hybrid compressor GUI (LZ77 + rANS + dict codec)
bundle.longDescription: NexusRAR is the desktop GUI for NexusCompress, a hybrid compressor combining LZ77 lazy matching with a 5-stream rANS entropy coder and a per-block dictionary codec. Sprint 4.0 ships a Next.js + Tailwind dark-cyberpunk UI on top of the Tauri 2.x runtime.
